usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.threads.messages.create("thread_id", role="user", content="string", attachments=[{"file_id": "string", "tools": [{"type": "code_interpreter"}]}], metadata={"key": "string"})
print(result)

fields.name: role
fields.description:
The role of the entity that is creating the message. Allowed values include:
- `user`: Indicates the message is sent by an actual user and should be used in most cases to represent user-generated messages.
- `assistant`: Indicates the message is generated by the assistant. Use this value to insert messages from the assistant into the conversation.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread.message`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was created.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: The [thread](/docs/api-reference/threads) ID that this message belongs to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the message, which can be either `in_progress`, `incomplete`, or `completed`.

fields.name: role
fields.description: The entity that produced the message. One of `user` or `assistant`.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The content of the message in array of text and/or images.
